nodes.summary: For $r \in \mathbb{N}$, the generating series of the bi-brackets of depth $r$ is the formal power series in the variables $X_1, \dots, X_r$, $Y_1, \dots, Y_r$ with coefficients in $\mathbb{Q}[[q]]$

nodes.summary: The bi-bracket of the empty index is $1$: $g(\varnothing; \varnothing) = 1$.

nodes.title: Bi-brackets

nodes.summary: For $r \in \mathbb{N}$ and exponents $a_1, \dots, a_r, b_1, \dots, b_r \ge 0$, the coefficient of $\prod_{j=1}^{r} X_j^{a_j} Y_j^{b_j}$ in the generating series $g(X_1, \dots, X_r; Y_1, \dots, Y_r)$ of bi-brackets of depth $r$ is the bi-bracket $g(a_1 + 1, \dots, a_r + 1; b_1, \dots, b_r)$.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the bi-bracket generating series

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$, $m$ and $n$ with $m > 0$ and $n > 0$, the coefficient of $q^{mn}$ in the Eulerian $q$-series $\sum_{\ell \ge 1} \frac{\ell^{k-1}}{(k-1)!} q^{m\ell}$ is $\frac{n^{k-1}}{(k-1)!}$, where $k - 1$ is read as $0$ when $k = 0$.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the Eulerian q-series

nodes.summary: For $r \in \mathbb{N}$ and exponents $a_1, \dots, a_r, b_1, \dots, b_r \ge 0$, the coefficient of $\prod_{j=1}^{r} X_j^{a_j} Y_j^{b_j}$ in the generating series $s(X_1, \dots, X_r; Y_1, \dots, Y_r)$ of Schlesinger–Zudilin $q$-multiple zeta values of depth $r$ is $\zeta_q^{\mathrm{SZ}}(a_1 + 1, \{0\}^{b_1}, \dots, a_r + 1, \{0\}^{b_r})$, where $\{0\}^b$ stands for $b$ consecutive zeros.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the SZ generating series

nodes.summary: The Okounkov polynomials of index $2$ and $3$ are $p_2(X) = X$ and $p_3(X) = X(1 + X)$.
nodes.title: The Okounkov polynomials $p_2$ and $p_3$

nodes.summary: For $k \in \mathbb{N}$, the Okounkov polynomial $p_k \in \mathbb{Q}[X]$ is $p_k(X) = X^{k/2}$ if $k$ is even and $p_k(X) = X^{(k-1)/2}(1 + X)$ if $k$ is odd.
nodes.title: Okounkov polynomials

nodes.summary: The Okounkov $q$-multiple zeta value of the empty index is $1$: $\zeta_q^{\mathrm{Oko}}(\varnothing) = 1$.
nodes.title: Okounkov qMZV of the empty index

nodes.summary: For a natural number $k$ let $p_k$ be Okounkov's polynomial: $p_k(X) = X^{k/2}$ if $k$ is even and $p_k(X) = X^{(k-1)/2}(1 + X)$ if $k$ is odd. For an index $(k_1, \dots, k_r)$ of natural numbers, the Okounkov qMZV is the general qMZV $\zeta_q^{\mathrm{Oko}}(k_1, \dots, k_r) = \zeta_q(k_1, \dots, k_r; p_{k_1}, \dots, p_{k_r})$, a formal power series in $q$ over $\mathbb{Q}$.
nodes.title: Okounkov $q$-multiple zeta values

nodes.summary: For every natural number $d$, the constant power series $1$ (the qMZV of the empty index) lies in the space $\mathcal{Z}^\circ_{q,d}$.
nodes.title: The constant $1$ lies in $\mathcal{Z}^\circ_{q,d}$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $d$, the space $\mathcal{Z}^\circ_{q,d}$ is a subspace of $\mathcal{Z}_{q,d}$.
nodes.title: $\mathcal{Z}^\circ_{q,d}$ is contained in $\mathcal{Z}_{q,d}$

nodes.summary: The space $\mathcal{Z}^\circ_{q,1}$ equals the $\mathbb{Q}$-linear span of the Okounkov qMZVs $\zeta_q^{\mathrm{Oko}}(k_1, \dots, k_r)$ over all indices of length $r \ge 0$ with every $k_i \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Okounkov qMZVs span $\mathcal{Z}^\circ_{q,1}$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, the space $\mathcal{Z}^\circ_{q,d}$ is the $\mathbb{Q}$-linear span, in the formal power series ring $\mathbb{Q}[[q]]$, of the general qMZVs $\zeta_q(k_1, \dots, k_r; Q_1, \dots, Q_r)$ over all $r \ge 0$, natural numbers $k_1, \dots, k_r$ and polynomials $Q_1, \dots, Q_r \in \mathbb{Q}[X]$ such that for every $j$ we have $k_j \ge 1$, $\deg Q_j + d \le k_j$ and $Q_j(0) = 0$. nodes.title: The spaces $\mathcal{Z}^\circ_{q,d}$

nodes.summary: Let $\overline{\mathbb{N}}$ consist of the positive integers and one further symbol $\bar 1$. The space $\mathcal{Z}_q = \mathcal{Z}_{q,0}$ equals the $\mathbb{Q}$-linear span of the TBZ-qMZVs $\zeta_q^{\mathrm{TBZ}}(k_1, \dots, k_r)$ over all $r \ge 0$ and all $k_1, \dots, k_r \in \overline{\mathbb{N}}$ with $k_1 \ne 1$ when $r \ge 1$.
nodes.title: The Takeyama–Bradley–Zhao model spans $\mathcal{Z}_q$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$, the generating series of SZ-qMZVs of depth $r$ is the formal power series in the $2r$ variables $X_1, \dots, X_r, Y_1, \dots, Y_r$ with coefficients in $\mathbb{Q}[[q]]$
nodes.title: Generating series of Schlesinger–Zudilin qMZVs

nodes.summary: For every index $(k_1, \dots, k_r)$ of natural numbers, read as a TBZ index without the symbol $\bar 1$, the TBZ-qMZV equals the Bradley–Zhao qMZV: $\zeta_q^{\mathrm{TBZ}}(k_1, \dots, k_r) = \zeta_q^{\mathrm{BZ}}(k_1, \dots, k_r)$.
nodes.title: The TBZ model extends the BZ model

nodes.summary: The Takeyama–Bradley–Zhao qMZV of the empty index is $1$: $\zeta_q^{\mathrm{TBZ}}(\varnothing) = 1$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
